title: Anticipatory eviction hinting and soft-failback hotpatch
author: Maya Chen
commits: hotfix: add anticipatory eviction hint pipeline
feat: soft-failback coordinator and probe windowing
test: kv pressure regression tests + canary harness
docs: operator notes and rollout playbook
description:
Motivation: In recent incidents (SUP-3210) we observed region-level failovers that performed full KV drain and aggressive tenant eviction, then immediately attempted global failback. This caused re-add storms and repeated cold-KV misses, amplifying latency spikes for warm traffic. This PR introduces an anticipatory eviction hint pipeline plus a soft-failback coordinator that spaces rejoin attempts and uses a telemetry-backed feedback loop to reduce thundering reattach behavior.

Summary of changes: Added a small standalone module (runtime/eviction/anticipatory_hint.go) that computes per-tenant eviction 'pressure' hints derived from short EWMA windows of KV pressure, inflight tokens, and tenant weight. The coordinator (serving/coordinator/soft_failback.go) consumes hints and gates soft rejoin attempts using a configurable probe window and a cooldown TTL per-node. Eviction actions are now annotated with hint metadata so downstream telemetry can attribute cost and latency impacts. Feature is behind a runtime feature-flag (deploy/feature-flags.yaml) and defaults to disabled for existing customers; we enabled it in the regional canary.

Design notes and tradeoffs: The hint heuristic is intentionally conservative — it biases against aggressive eviction unless the hint score crosses a higher threshold and sustained for 3 samples. This trades slightly slower eviction during pathological spikes for fewer repeated cold reloads. The soft-failback coordinator implements a backoff that is reset only when the region's KV miss-rate and CPU load have returned below configured thresholds, preventing immediate flip-flops. We chose EWMA (alpha=0.2) for responsiveness with stability.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests cover heuristic edge cases and saturating inputs (runtime/eviction/heuristics_test.go). Integration kv_pressure canary run (integration/kv_pressure/canary_config.json) simulates regional drain/rejoin cycles; the e2e-canary target validated stable rejoin behavior over 45m. Rollout plan: enable feature-flag in one regional serving pool for 24h, observe eviction_map and slo_breakdown dashboards, then expand to other pools in two-phase canary. We performed a controlled hotpatch rollout using scripts/canary/run_canary.sh.

Observability: New metrics: eviction_hint_score{tenant_id}, soft_rejoin_attempt, soft_rejoin_success, rejoin_cooldown_seconds. Dashboards added at observability/dashboards/eviction_map.yaml and an operator playbook in docs/operator/playbooks/soft-failback.md describing runbooks and debug commands.

Backward compatibility and safety: The change is non-breaking; the feature is opt-in via feature-flag. Default behavior remains unchanged for tenants without the flag. All state changes are recorded in audit logs to aid incident replay.

Rollback plan: Toggle feature-flag off to stop the hinting/coordinator immediately. A fast-path cleanup job is included to clear coordinator timers (serving/coordinator/cleanup.go) if needed. If we see regressions during canary (metric thresholds in playbook exceeded), we will revert the deployment revision and disable the feature-flag.

Related work: builds on earlier regional backoff efforts (ENG-7743) and complements the KV-preserve fastpath.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for heuristic
- [x] Integration canary config + runbook
- [x] Observability hooks and dashboards
- [x] Feature-flag gating and deploy manifests
- [x] Stakeholder review (SRE, runtime, product)

Impact: In canary we saw a ~35% reduction in repeated cold-KV misses during staggered rejoin scenarios and a 12% reduction in 95th latency on warm tenants affected by failure/rejoin cycles.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the probation window logic in serving/coordinator/soft_failback.go (safety) and the hint aggregation boundary conditions in anticipatory_hint.go (stability). The heuristic intentionally keeps simple math to remain auditable in incident postmortems.
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: LGTM overall; please add a small note documenting the expected metric units (eviction_hint_score is 0..1) — addressed in metrics.go
Priya Natarajan: Can we expose the probation window and thresholds as runtime knobs? Response: added to deploy/feature-flags.yaml and config comments; kept defaults conservative
Liam O'Connor: Please include a quick rollback verification command in the playbook — added under operator/debug-commands in docs/operator/playbooks/soft-failback.md
release_notes: Hotpatch: Adds anticipatory eviction hinting and soft-failback coordinator to reduce repeated cold-KV misses during regional failovers. Opt-in via feature flag. Improves stability of rejoin windows and reduces 95th latency for warm tenants in canary tests.
